In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Draft this email in this person's authentic voice and email register.
        Ground every claim in the thread history, established facts, and private
        knowledge given; never invent documents, people, meetings, or prior
        statements not present in them. The summary must honestly compress what
        the email commits to.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Lucia Mendes, Senior Accountant, Tax (mid).
Senior tax accountant: partnerships and the individual returns, K-1 season quarterback, keeps the Stonebridge relationship humming.
Personality: Composed under load, dry wit, hates loose ends.
Email register: Crisp and cordial; signs 'Lucia'.
Chat register: Short, precise, occasionally deadpan.
Working hours: 08:30-17:30

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
Subject: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Tenant Follow-Up

Gabriel, Lucia,

We are revisiting the CAM reconciliation for the tenant flagged in our prior correspondence. The disputed items have resurfaced, and we need to close this out before the end of the quarter.

Please provide the supporting documentation and a revised schedule by end of day Friday. I need your commitment on the final figures so we can send the tenant a definitive response next week.

Best,
Evan Doyle

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Tenant Follow-Up

Evan,

Thanks for the nudge. I have pulled the supporting documentation for the disputed CAM items—the original lease exhibit, the expense allocation schedules, and the prior reconciliation notes—and placed them in the shared folder under 'CAM Dispute – Q3'. 

Here is where I stand on the revised schedule: I have re-ran the numbers using the corrected square footage split for the tenant’s pro-rata share, and the variance on the disputed line items is largely attributable to a timing difference on one utility invoice that was cut in the previous period but posted late. That adjustment brings the reconciliation within the tenant’s expected range, and I have a final revised schedule ready for your review.

I am committing to a definitive figure of $18,432 as the net CAM amount due for the period, subject to your sign-off on the attached schedule. I can have the final package emailed to you by end of day Thursday, which gives us a buffer before Friday’s deadline.

Happy to walk through the schedule if you want to review the numbers together—let me know what works.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Tenant Follow-Up

Gabriel, Lucia,

Thank you for the update, Gabriel. I appreciate the quick turnaround and the documentation you've pulled together. Your commitment to the revised figure of $18,432 is noted, and I will take that as our working number pending my review of the schedule.

Please ensure the final package, including the corrected pro-rata allocation and the utility timing adjustment, is in my inbox by end of day Thursday as promised. I will review it Thursday evening and provide any final comments before we send the tenant a definitive response next week.

Lucia, please coordinate with Gabriel to confirm the supporting documents are complete and that we have a clean audit trail for this reconciliation. I want no loose ends on this before we close the quarter.

Confirm receipt of this email by end of day today.

Best,
Evan Doyle

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Tenant Follow-Up

Evan,

Confirming receipt of your email and your commitment to the $18,432 figure as our working number. The final package, including the corrected pro-rata allocation and the utility timing adjustment note, will be in your inbox by end of day Thursday as promised.

I have also verified with Lucia that the supporting documentation in the shared folder is complete—the original lease exhibit, expense allocation schedules, and prior reconciliation notes are all in place. I will include a brief cover memo in the package summarizing the adjustments and the audit trail for each disputed line item, so you have everything you need for your Thursday evening review.

If anything is unclear after you go through it, I’m available Thursday morning for a quick call to walk through any specifics.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes
